description: Your outcomes, over every business of your account (one business's only with business; businesses names what they cover): decisions Trustpilot made on your filed cases (removed, retained, amended, withdrawn), the win rate and median days to a decision computed from those decisions, the same per Trustpilot reason the reports were filed under (by_reason) and per month Trustpilot decided (by_month, oldest first), and removals: how many reviews Trustpilot removed after your reports, how many of those RepuTend has since seen gone from Trustpilot, and reviews that disappeared with no removal by Trustpilot recorded (their reviewer may have deleted them). Every review you approved or reported that is gone from Trustpilot is charged as a removal, however it went; a review you never approved or reported never is. Show the per-reason results as a table of reason, decided, removed and kept online. by_month is a series for a chart of removed and kept online per month, when the client can draw one.

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

business.description: The business to act on, by its domain (such as example.com), one of those list_businesses shows. Needed only when your accounts track more than one business.

name: get_outcomes
title: Show dispute outcomes
